_meta.derivation: As HY-V1 with content padded so both attestation frames exceed the 4096-byte KMS RAW limit (the genuine capture's F-G3 is 6753 bytes); the kms signature is made from mu, as A9.6's pass condition requires above 4 KB, and is an ordinary signature over F.
_meta.title: Full hybrid receipt with frames over 4096 bytes (6753 / 6752), signed by external mu
